full_name: Lucía F. Franchini | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Biological Sciences Helen Putnam Fellow CONICET (Argentina)
bio: Lucía F. Franchini is a molecular evolutionary biologist based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, whose aim is to unravel the genetic bases underlying the evolution of the human brain.
